reason: This plugin is primarily a memory management utility for DeepSeek Harness agents: it maintains cross-session structured memory and exposes agent-facing tools to read, write, index, archive, and roll back memory entries. Evidence indicates it is designed for workflow/context support inside DSH sessions through namespaced file-backed storage and per-turn prompt-context injection, with no separate external service integration shown.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆能力的插件，支持按命名空间管理记忆并提供读取、写入、归档和回滚等操作工具。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for cross-session memory, offering namespace-aware memory operations such as read, write, list, archive, and rollback via agent-facing tools.

capabilities: Cross-session persistent memory storage and retrieval
Runtime tools for listing/reading/writing/updating/archiving/rolling back memory entries
Per-turn context index injection for model prompts
Automatic candidate maintenance and periodic cleanup

reasons.code: Repository README documents a DSH cross-session long-term memory plugin with namespace isolation and layered memory (L1/L2/L3).
README lists runtime tools such as memory_read, memory_write, memory_archive, memory_rollback, memory_list, and memory_maintain, showing runtime behavior and command surface.
README describes each turn L1 index injection via ctx.systemPrompt.context and storage under ~/.dsh/memory with facts.md, sops, pending, archive, and .history paths.
Package manifest marks a DSH plugin bundle via cordis.patch.yml and sets lib/index.js as entry, indicating integration with the DSH runtime skill/tool system.
Repository topics and keywords include long-term-memory and deepseek-harness, matching an agent memory/context function rather than external network or media tooling.
